== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Visiria refers to both a species and its home planet. The [[Visiri]] are a superhuman race characterized by having three eyes, which allow them to perceive life energy. They possess a natural affinity for [[Combat Arts]] and are known for their immense physical strength, capable of damaging starship plating with their hands. While they generally have a weaker connection to the [[Aether]] than other intelligent species, many [[Visiri]] warriors utilize red energy auras and specialized weaponry. The species includes various types of individuals, from genial warriors to heavily modified [[Reavers]] with mechanical limbs and eyes. The planet Visiria is a major component of the [[Karoshan Alliance]], serving as its second most powerful member. The world features a climate that results in brown-looking continents and lush, floating jungle islands. It is governed by [[Nelula Seiren]] and contains significant landmarks such as an ancient temple in the southeast that features combat-enhancing etchings. The planet's history is marked by warfare and recent conflicts, including an invasion by the [[D’Niss]]. The [[Visiria system]] is also home to a powerful and volatile [[World Spirit]]. While the planet remains outside of [[Galactic Union]] control, it maintains access to the [[Union Subline]] and holds divided opinions regarding the group known as [[The Last Horizon]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Visiria is a blue planet and a major component of the [[Karoshan Alliance]] that remains largely independent from [[The Empire|the Empire]]. This world is characterized by a jungle of floating plant islands and serves as the location for the [[Prime Coliseum]]. While its navy is not notable on a galactic scale, the planet contains many ships and is considered a major system that the [[Swarm-Queen]] might feed on. Although forming an alliance with Visiria is a goal and the [[Titan Knight]] is believed to be located there, a group of [[Perfected]] moved toward the planet. Ultimately, despite [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] working on the world, the people of Visiria suffered a loss.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Visiria is a significant planet located within the [[Visiria system]], which maintains populations across every world in its territory. Governed by [[Nelula Seiren]], the planet exists outside of [[Galactic Union]] control despite possessing access to the [[Union Subline]]. Several weeks prior to recent events, the world suffered an attack by the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]]. Following this assault, the [[Vallenar Corporation]] began conducting an assessment of the planet's assets.}}
